# std.jobs

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Durable jobs on SQLite, for one host: deduplicated ingestion, typed and
versioned job state with explicit step transitions, an outbox committed
in the same transaction as each transition, worker leases with fencing,
dispatch with stable operation keys and persisted receipts, explicit
uncertainty, durable timers, bounded retries, cancellation, inspection,
state migrations, and backups.

Every change is one SQLite transaction (WAL journal, synchronous FULL):
a crash leaves the store at the last committed transition. A transition
commits only while its worker's lease holds and its fence (a counter
bumped by every claim and cancellation) is unchanged, so a worker whose
lease expired cannot commit stale state. The dangerous interval, when a
destination acted but its receipt is not committed yet, is not hidden: an
outbox entry is marked `sending` (committed) before it is sent, and one
still `sending` after its send deadline (because the dispatcher crashed or
hung) becomes `uncertain`. Uncertain entries are never sent again
automatically: `reconcile` asks the destination by operation key, or an
operator `resolve`s them. Destinations should treat the operation key as
an idempotency key.

Errors from SQLite (including a full disk) are returned and roll the
transaction back. Not provided: replication or recovery from losing the
machine, and persisting anything but `Codec` values (no closures, tasks,
channels, or scopes).

## Types

### `Claim`

```lang
struct Claim { pub id: String, pub kind: String, pub version: Int, pub step: String, pub attempts: Int, pub fence: Int, state: String }
```

A job claimed by a worker: its identity, state version, the step it
reached, its failed attempts so far, and the fence its transitions
must match.

#### `Claim.state`

```lang
fn state<T>(self: &Self) -> Result<T, Error> where T: Codec
```

The job's state (of the claim's `version`).

### `Entry`

```lang
struct Entry { pub id: Int, pub job: String, pub key: String, pub kind: String, pub payload: String, pub status: String, pub receipt: Option<String>, pub attempts: Int } derive(Codec, Display)
```

An outbox entry: `pending`, `sending`, `confirmed`, `rejected`,
`uncertain`, or `cancelled`, with the receipt or reason recorded for it.

### `Error`

```lang
struct Error { pub code: Symbol, pub message: String }
```

A job store operation failed: a database error (`code` from SQLite), a
state that does not decode (`:jobs/decode`), a transition by a worker
that lost its claim (`:jobs/lease_lost`) or whose job was cancelled
(`:jobs/cancelled`), an operation key reused with a different payload
(`:jobs/operation_conflict`), or an unknown store layout
(`:jobs/schema`).

#### `Error.code`

```lang
fn code(self: &Self) -> Symbol
```

#### `Error.display`

```lang
fn display(self: &Self) -> String
```

#### `Error.from`

```lang
fn from(e: sqlite.Error) -> Self
```

### `Job`

```lang
struct Job { pub id: String, pub kind: String, pub version: Int, pub status: String, pub step: String, pub attempts: Int, pub max_attempts: Int, pub run_at: Int, pub owner: Option<String>, pub error: Option<String>, pub created: Int, pub updated: Int } derive(Codec, Display)
```

A job as stored.

### `Next`

```lang
enum Next { again, after(delay: Duration), done, failed(reason: String) }
```

What a transition does with the job.

### `Outcome`

```lang
enum Outcome { confirmed(receipt: String), rejected(reason: String), not_sent(reason: String), uncertain(reason: String) }
```

What happened to a sent (or checked) operation.

### `Send`

```lang
struct Send { pub key: String, pub kind: String, pub payload: String }
```

An external operation to dispatch after the transition commits. `key`
identifies it for good (an idempotency key): adding the same key again
(for example from a retried step) does nothing.

### `Store`

```lang
struct Store<S> { pool: sqlite.Pool<S> }
```

A job store (one SQLite database file; several processes may share it).

#### `Store.advance`

```lang
fn advance<T>(self: &Self, c: &Claim, step: String, version: Int, state: T, next: Next, sends: List<Send>) -> Result<Unit, Error> !{Io, Wait} where T: Codec
```

Commit a step: the job's new state (of `version`) and step name, what
happens next, and the external operations it decided on, in one
transaction that holds only while the claim does. A successful step
resets the failed-attempt count.

#### `Store.backup`

```lang
fn backup(self: &Self, path: String) -> Result<Unit, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Write a consistent copy of the store to `path` (SQLite `VACUUM
INTO`; the file must not exist).

#### `Store.cancel`

```lang
fn cancel(self: &Self, id: String, reason: String) -> Result<Bool, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Cancel a job that has not finished: a worker holding it can no longer
commit, and its operations not yet sent are cancelled (one already
sent cannot be taken back). Returns whether it was cancelled.

#### `Store.claim`

```lang
fn claim(self: &Self, kind: String, owner: String, lease: Duration) -> Result<Option<Claim>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Claim the next due job of `kind` for `owner` for `lease`: a ready job
whose time has come, or a running one whose lease expired (that
counts as a failed attempt). Each claim bumps the job's fence.

#### `Store.count`

```lang
fn count(self: &Self, status: String) -> Result<Int, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Jobs per status, for monitoring.

#### `Store.dispatch`

```lang
fn dispatch(self: &Self, kind: String, limit: Int, timeout: Duration, send: fn(Entry) -> Outcome) -> Result<List<Entry>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Send pending operations of `kind` (oldest first, at most `limit`)
with `send`. Each is marked `sending` with a deadline of `timeout`
(committed) before `send` runs, and its outcome is committed after.
First, entries still `sending` past their deadline become
`uncertain`; they are not sent again (see `reconcile`). Returns the
entries handled, as they ended.

#### `Store.history`

```lang
fn history(self: &Self, id: String) -> Result<List<Transition>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

A job's transitions, oldest first.

#### `Store.job`

```lang
fn job(self: &Self, id: String) -> Result<Option<Job>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

A job by id.

#### `Store.jobs`

```lang
fn jobs(self: &Self, status: String) -> Result<List<Job>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Jobs with `status` (oldest first).

#### `Store.migrate`

```lang
fn migrate<A, B>(self: &Self, kind: String, from: Int, to: Int, f: fn(A) -> B) -> Result<Int, Error> !{Io, Wait} where A: Codec, B: Codec
```

Rewrite the state of every unfinished job of `kind` at version
`from` with `f`, to version `to`, in one transaction (a job crossing
a code change either keeps an executor for its old version or is
migrated). Returns how many jobs changed.

#### `Store.operation`

```lang
fn operation(self: &Self, key: String) -> Result<Option<Entry>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

The outbox entry for an operation key (with its receipt, once sent).

#### `Store.operations`

```lang
fn operations(self: &Self, status: String) -> Result<List<Entry>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Outbox entries with `status` (oldest first).

#### `Store.reconcile`

```lang
fn reconcile(self: &Self, kind: String, check: fn(Entry) -> Outcome) -> Result<List<Entry>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Ask the destination about uncertain operations of `kind` (by their
keys) with `check`, and record what it says; an operation it cannot
confirm or rule out stays uncertain for an operator to `resolve`.
`not_sent` sends it again later.

#### `Store.renew`

```lang
fn renew(self: &Self, c: &Claim, lease: Duration) -> Result<Unit, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Extend a claim's lease (while it is still held).

#### `Store.resolve`

```lang
fn resolve(self: &Self, key: String, outcome: Outcome) -> Result<Bool, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

An operator's decision about an uncertain operation.

#### `Store.retry`

```lang
fn retry(self: &Self, c: &Claim, error: String, backoff: Duration) -> Result<Bool, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Record a failed attempt: the job is ready again after `backoff`, or
failed for good once it has failed `max_attempts` times. Returns
whether it will run again.

#### `Store.settle`

```lang
fn settle(self: &Self, e: Entry, outcome: Outcome) -> Result<Entry, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

#### `Store.submit`

```lang
fn submit<T>(self: &Self, kind: String, event: String, version: Int, state: T, max_attempts: Int) -> Result<Submitted, Error> !{Io, Wait} where T: Codec
```

Ingest an event: create job `kind:event` in its first state, unless
an event with this key was ingested before (then nothing changes).
The job may fail `max_attempts` times before it fails for good.

#### `Store.take`

```lang
fn take(self: &Self, id: Int, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Option<Entry>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

### `Submitted`

```lang
enum Submitted { created(id: String), duplicate(id: String) }
```

Whether `submit` created a job or the event was seen before.

### `Transition`

```lang
struct Transition { pub at: Int, pub step: String, pub status: String, pub note: Option<String> } derive(Codec, Display)
```

One recorded transition of a job.

## Functions

### `open`

```lang
fn open<S: Scope>(path: String) -> Result<Store<S>, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Open (creating if needed) the job store in the SQLite database `path`.
